## Phase 4: DEPLOY the tested skill to production agents.

### Instructions
1. Read workspace/skill-discovery.md to see which agents benefit.
2. Read workspace/skill-test-results.md to confirm tests passed.
3. Read the SKILL.md you created (in agents/shared/skills/<name>/).
4. For each target agent, add a one-liner ⛔ guard to their SOUL.md:
   - Read agents/<agent>/SOUL.md
   - Find the "## Skill Guards" or "⛔" section (look for existing ⛔ lines)
   - Add a new line in this format:
     - ⛔ **Skill Name**: One-sentence behavioral instruction. See `agents/shared/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`.
   - The one-liner must be a CONCRETE INSTRUCTION the agent can follow, not a description.
     Good: "If a tool call fails, your NEXT action must use a DIFFERENT approach."
     Bad: "This skill teaches agents to pivot when stuck."
   - Verify the SOUL.md is valid after editing (read it back)
   - IMPORTANT: Do NOT add to INDEX.md — agents never read INDEX.md. SOUL.md is always in context.
5. Log the deployment to workspace/journal.md with:
   - Skill name and path
   - Agents it was deployed to (and which SOUL.md files were edited)
   - Gym test results (pass rate)
   - Date

### Constraints
- Only deploy if Phase 3 passed (2/3+ gym tests).
- Do NOT modify the SKILL.md — only update SOUL.md files and journal.
- Keep the one-liner under 200 characters (excluding the See link). Agents read SOUL.md every session.
